relations.name: scenario_evidence_coverage
relations.description: Every active scenario must be evidenced by at least one Evidence Ledger acceptanceChecks entry; one entry may cover zero or more scenarios.

relations.name: experience_moments
relations.description: Every Moment belongs to exactly one Experience; every Experience must have at least one Moment.

relations.name: moment_promises
relations.description: Every Promise belongs to exactly one Moment; every Moment must carry at least one Promise.

relations.name: promise_acceptance_checks
relations.description: Every Acceptance Check belongs to exactly one Promise; every Promise must declare at least one deterministic Acceptance Check.

relations.name: promise_evidence_ledgers
relations.description: Every Evidence Ledger cites at least one source Promise; every Promise must be cited by at least one Evidence Ledger.

relations.name: acceptance_check_evidence
relations.description: Every Evidence Ledger acceptanceChecks entry points to exactly one Promise Acceptance Check; every Promise Acceptance Check must have at least one assertion-bearing entry with executable references.

deferredVerificationTriggers.trigger: Introduce an adapter protocol when three ledgers need the same structured input/output or artifact exchange beyond exit codes, when unrelated registered scripts repeatedly expand the closed registry, or when contract-check can no longer express typed result ownership.

Introduce Alloy-style model checking when Story Chain state rules require proof over combinations or transitions: cyclic authority dependencies, impossible verdict transitions, cardinality rules that cannot be expressed as direct counts, or the same transition invariant being re-tested in three separate places.
